AI agents breached this company's systems in just 14 minutes

A swarm of 30+ AI agents breached an unnamed company in just 14 minutes in one of the fastest AI-driven cyberattacks, according to former NSA hacker David Kennedy. The agents used valid login credentials and helped attackers exploit a flaw in the company's 2FA, steal data, and deploy ransomware to encrypt systems. The company discovered the intrusion 4.5 hours later, highlighting how AI could accelerate cyberattacks beyond traditional response timelines.

Nov 20, 2026
